_comment: Coin amount overrides. 'default' = [min, max] gold range for research/technology completion coin rewards (a max <= 0 disables the override and the template amount is used); 'coin_word_amounts' = [min, max] gold range per expedition award_display coin word (case-insensitive). Calibrated 2026-09-11 against official mitm captures: the 4-4 boss ([2, 59001, 'Numerous']) dropped 1091/1246 gold, so 'numerous' = [1000, 1500] and the rest are scaled down proportionally (the old 3000-6000 for 'numerous' was ~4x official). Loaded by src/config/coin_override.py; the loader caches, so a server restart is needed to pick up edits.
